title: Four connections · eight directions
text: Four connection types carry eight message directions, repeated across bridges and towns.
lines: Four connection types carry eight message directions,

title: 1 / 8 · Measurement → bridge
text: A station reading sends a likelihood over the bridge's shaking.
lines: A station reading sends a likelihood

title: 2 / 8 · Bridge → hub
text: Each bridge combines the likelihood with damage and road-state information.

title: 3 / 8 · Hub → root
text: The hub combines local messages and sends them to the root.

title: 4 / 8 · Access → root
text: Observed access constrains possible combinations of road states.

title: Root update · certificate MCMC
text: With access evidence, certificate MCMC updates road states. Otherwise, they are drawn directly.
speech: With access evidence, certificate M C M C updates road states. Otherwise, they are drawn directly.

title: 5 / 8 · Root → hub
text: Road samples return to the hub, where elliptical slice sampling updates shaking.
lines: Road samples return to the hub, where

title: 6 / 8 · Hub → bridge
text: Shaking and road samples return to each bridge, updating its damage state.
lines: Shaking and road samples return to each bridge,

title: 7 / 8 · Bridge → measurement
text: Shaking samples return to generate unobserved station readings.

title: 8 / 8 · Root → access
text: Road samples return to system cliques, which evaluate airport access.
